notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 小纸条增加手绘信纸背景；回复优先显示缓存、图片独立加载；经期入口常驻，未设置或未授权时显示操作提示；开屏仅保留加载动画。包含生日资料、女性授权伴侣代录及网络切换恢复优化。
notes.en: Hand-drawn stationery for notes, cached replies with independent image loading, a persistent period entry with setup and permission guidance, and a text-free startup loading indicator. Includes profile birthdays, owner-approved partner period recording, and network recovery improvements.
